fusions.name: Capsule Crack
fusions.desc: A seed capsule bursts open and fires a seed that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Splinter Report
fusions.desc: Your bark bursts outward in a cone of splinters, dealing 14 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Seasoned Stock
fusions.desc: Your grain dries and hardens to a gunstock's: your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Primed Resin
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, resin primes in your bark and your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
